backend.activations: f16 residual stream, norms and MLP
backend.attention: f32 q/k/v (bias + rotate-half RoPE fused kernel, cos/sin from f64 on host); one f32 flash-style kernel for all segments of a forward (online softmax, additive block mask, prefix K/V read from the cache, fully masked key tiles skipped), GQA as stacked query rows
backend.kernels: fused: q/k/v and gate/up projections as single GEMMs without bias; bias added in fused kernels (bias+RoPE+head split, bias+SiLU*up, bias+residual)
backend.readout: letter rows of lm_head only, f32
backend.padding: none: compact token list for GEMM/norm/MLP, attention per packed row (segment)
backend.gemm: cuBLASLt, f32 accumulation; algorithm per (N, K, M class: 16 up to 512, then 128) from the --gemm-table search, else the fastest of up to 16 heuristic algorithms timed at first use
backend.last_layer: o_proj and MLP of the last layer only at the readout positions

host_math: softmax, order average and calibration in f64
